Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
STAGE: Stage 2/5 'finland | palus' (gravel, 3.2 mi). Timer FROZEN at 59:59.000 all session; never advances. No finish, results, checkpoint, split or progress metric ever observed on this stage. Stage 1/5 completion still unresolved.

CORE MECHANIC (observed): sustained input needed. Held 0.9-1.4 s beats reliably move the car; sub-1 s taps often change only the speed readout.

CONTROLS (confirmed): W throttle, S brake/reverse, A/D steer, Enter confirm, Down moves highlight. Menu order: continue / ghosts off / restart / stage results / rally results / leaderboard / view replay / options / save and quit / retire from season; cursor not reliably on 'continue'. Escape (0.1 s, 0.5 s) failed to open pause in the frozen-timer state; pointer clicks on menu rows do nothing. Attract cinematics letterboxed, unskippable.

BLACK FADE / FREE RESET (now 7+ times, observed): full black frame, no HUD; resolves alone in ~3 s, repositioning the car CENTRED on wide gravel at 0-4 mph, gear 1. It interrupts normal centred driving (after clean 15 mph beats twice), so not a crash or pin consequence. Correct response: WAIT (4 s), never Enter. First beat after a fade is reliably plain W.

HAZARD GEOMETRY (new, key): at the marshalled junction a DIAGONAL line of hay bales + Oli striped boards separates the LEFT branch (climbs to the RED BARN = the course) from the right branch the car arrived on. Passage is around the barrier's UPPER-LEFT end, not straight ahead. Observed fix: S-only 0.9 s from nose-on bale -> 7 mph gear R, clean disengage; then W+A 1.2 s carried the car through the gap onto the barn road.

BARN STRAIGHT: wide and forgiving; plain W gave 2->14 mph in one beat. But the NEXT plain W beat ran the car off the right side into the barn's white fence, nose-on pin at 0 mph gear 1. Standard recovery: S-only 1.0 s -> 7 mph R; then W+A 1.2 s (4 mph) threading pines; continued W+A 1.1 s -> 10 mph back on gravel past the barn.

STEERING COST (harsh, well supported; new extreme): W+A at 22 mph cost 16 mph (22->6 in 0.6 s). Earlier: W+A 15->4 (-11), W+D 13->7 (-6), W+A 14->5 (-9), W+D 12->9 (-3). Rule: never steer above ~15 mph; correct only when visibly off-road; elsewhere let the wide gravel absorb gentle bends. Corrections at 7-11 mph cost ~0-3 mph.

CORRECTION PATTERN THAT WORKS (10+ successes): one 1.0-1.3 s combined W + steer toward the road crosses 2-5 car widths of grass and usually lands the car centred (7->10, 9->9, 7->11, 9->13 mph). Over-correction is common: W+A then W+D in successive beats. DRIFT DIRECTION FLIPS beat to beat on pine straights and post-lined bends, so derive steer direction from the CURRENT frame's road position, never from the last correction.

GRASS: very slow; plain W gains ~1-7 mph per 1.3 s; reverse in grass/pines only 2-3 mph per 1.0-1.3 s. Reverse is the shortest exit when the road lies behind.

SPEED RECORD: 22 mph new top (best prior 15). Clean climbs observed after resets: 1->15, 0->4, 2->14. Speed can also collapse (14->0 into fence, 10->0 wide in pines) even on open road.

SIX DOTS (still uninformative): pale observed 0-14 mph, blue at 2, 6, 9, 12, 13, 15, 22 mph. Best current guess (unverified): a throttle/acceleration indicator, not a speed bar. Blue-at-zero seen twice as a weak engagement precursor.

HUD MARKERS: 1-2 small red/pink markers beside the timer recur intermittently; now appeared alongside clean 11-22 mph driving with no measurable effect. A faint grey '+5s'-like text appeared right of the timer once at 14 mph on the barn straight after passing the barrier — NEW, meaning unknown, unverifiable while the timer is frozen. RED X at the right of the dot panel seen in reverse gear AND in forward gear 1 — the reverse-gear explanation is now weakened; meaning unknown.

ROUTE AS TRAVERSED (no checkpoint or HUD event ever): Nimkädda green arch -> wide S through pines -> left bend past birches/orange tree -> pink SPEEDART banners -> long straight with white posts and birches -> boulder MEADOW with lake, pool and crossing gravel road -> boulder cluster -> pine corridor with left gravel spur -> left bend with lake top-right -> lakeside pine-shaded straights (repeated right-verge drift) -> gentle left bend -> purple banner -> long pine straight -> LARGE marshalled junction with blue/red/white/orange posts + wide gravel apron -> bale/Oli barrier: pass upper-left end -> wide barn straight -> red barn with white fence (pin risk on the right) -> pine-flanked curves past the barn -> post-lined bends with spectators and lake, birches/orange tree -> boulder meadow again -> long wide centred straights after each black fade. Suggests the course may be looping/repeating terrain, or fades relocate along it.

REJECTIONS: 'observation_age_limit' occurred 3+ times earlier, leaving 0 mph gear 1 without undoing progress; once restored an off-road car onto gravel.

UNRESOLVED: whether the stage can finish at all; why the timer is frozen; meaning of the coloured junction posts, striped bale barrier, dot panel, red X and the two pink markers; meaning of the '+5s'-like text; whether pause is permanently dead; why black fades occur mid-drive and whether they are penalising or resetting position; whether repeated terrain means the route is looping.

ACTIVE GOAL: continue at 10-22 mph — plain W on centred gravel straight after resets; 1.0-1.3 s combined W+steer to regain gravel from grass; S-only to escape nose-on pins; no steering above ~15 mph; wait out black fades. Next immediate step: plain W beat from 0 mph centred on the wide gravel straight that curves gently right through pines, immediately after the seventh fade.
